about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. The map and the photographs run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); landscape is the same film at 16:9 for a feed or a screen, with a title-safe margin; square is a feed post, with the same title-safe margin as landscape at its sides and a little less at top and bottom. The image to post and the story card are the square and the reel at their closers' rest.
